title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith

meta.Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I apologize for making you all wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Mr. Shindo!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to meet with us today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be discussing what we need to do in preparation for our debut, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. After giving it a considerable amount of thought, I've put together a document for you all to look at...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is an overview of the marketing strategies for the bands who've debuted with us, as well as some artists who are seeing a lot of success right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These are the download figures for each first single... And here are the buyer demographics... Is it really okay for you to be showing us all this data?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, as long as this information doesn't leave here. It's certainly not for everyone to see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: U-Understood...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now that you've all had a chance to look at these figures, today I'd like to discuss how your band is going to be marketed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How we're going to be marketed?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. First, I'd like to start by asking you all a question. What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aspirations for our music...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That includes your goals in terms of your music, as well as who you want listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In order for us to come up with a marketing strategy for your band, it's imperative we know exactly what your goals are.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
For example...
Please look at the very first page of the document in front of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this person... They sing a lot of Miku songs for their streams.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, that's because they want to enjoy music alongside their fans.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As such, they concentrate their efforts on streaming, taking song requests and having as close a relationship as possible with their fans.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On top of their earnings from subscriptions and merchandise sales, their high view counts have made things very lucrative.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Take a look at this page!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They placed first in the TV program School Band Fest when they were still in high school, and have been working as pros ever since.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Their goal is to prove to everyone that their band is worth a listen.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Which is why they auditioned for that music talent program around the time of their debut. And when they won, it brought them popularity and name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As a result, greater numbers of people became interested in their shows and they now have an extremely supportive fan base.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're nothing like this other artist...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Exactly. And these are just a couple of examples. Your specific goals will greatly change how you'll be marketed and what you do as artists.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to hear what you wish to do and come up with a plan based on that.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
So, let me ask you again.
As pros, what would you like to do?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, what does Leo/need hope to achieve with its music?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about moving the hearts of those who listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I might've guessed.
After all, the performances I saw are why we're sitting here now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That being said, I'd like to know more. I want you all to dig deeper.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Deeper?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Think about what you've all felt as a band. What you've wished for. What you've hoped for...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There must be something more you want to achieve with your music besides moving the hearts of others...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If there is, I'd like for you to tell me about it. Now is your chance to tell me exactly what it is that you want your music to be about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: More than moving people's hearts...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But... What else is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes... But if it's hard for all four of you to come up with one answer, then we can also talk about what you feel individually.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Individually?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. Instead of Leo/need as a whole, we can talk about what you each wish to do. Please, don't hesitate to speak up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I want our music to be uplifting...
I want it to cheer people up.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Cheer people up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes... Back when Saku... After we played at the same venue as anemone, I started thinking about how to write a song about “understanding loneliness”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That time, I wrote a song while thinking about what I went through a long time ago... And I was so happy the crowd understood what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried writing a song that showed real empathy for someone who needed it. I wanted the listener to feel better after hearing it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to create more music like that.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, I definitely got that when you played that song during your battle against anemone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, what about you three?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our music and my singing to help bring people together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Initially, I was happy with just trying to put on performances that could move people's hearts. But now, I want to do more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our music to be something that can help bring people together. Just like how Miku songs brought us together.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika both know exactly what they want our music to be about...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What else is there besides wanting to move people's hearts?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: How about you two, Ms. Mochizuki, Ms. Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand what Ichika and Saki are saying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wanting to be there for those who are in need. Wanting to bring people together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I understand what they want to do...
But I can't honestly say that I have any concrete goals like they do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I don't have anything specific either...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see... Then, it sounds like you both need some time to think.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... We're so sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
No, that's perfectly fine.
I wasn't expecting to hear your answers today.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: If anything, you should think long and hard about this since it is going to have a profound effect on your band's future.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
So, please take your time.
And of course, I'm here to help any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...! Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
We'll talk about this again another time.
Until then, please think about what you wish to do.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also, there's nothing wrong with wanting to pursue the same goal as someone else, or one similar to your original goal. Try to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, once we have your individual goals in place, we'll figure out what Leo/need is going to try to achieve with its music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now, on to our next topic...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'd like to give you all an overview of what the process of debuting actually entails. Please take a look at this document regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! This part's about publicity photos... And this is about when our debut single's gonna release!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. Then, let's start discussing these points one at a time. Starting with...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, girls! What's up☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys gotta hear this!
Today, we went over to the record company to talk with Mr. Shindo!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: With Mr. Shindo? What did you all discuss?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'd love to hear all about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. So, it started with a discussion surrounding how we'll be marketed for our debut...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What you want your music to be about...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We were told the company needs to know that in order to come up with a marketing strategy for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
I definitely understand their reasoning.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that's kind of a tough question to ask yourselves after coming this far...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I couldn't come up with even a half-decent response when Mr. Shindo asked me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me neither...
I didn't feel comfortable saying anything in that moment...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry for causing you two so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, um... I just happened to get a chance to think about that not too long ago is all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, same! Plus, Mr. Shindo said you should take your time to think it through. There's no need to rush at all!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll try giving it some thought when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
It may take me some time, but I promise to come up with a satisfactory answer for when we next meet with Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
We'll be looking forward to what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if either of you get stuck, we'll be more than happy to listen or talk.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna help too!
I'll do whatever I can to get you through this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what else did you talk about today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
About the other things we need to do before we debut...
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, the bath's ready.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can go first. I'm sure you're all sweaty after practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you insist.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My aspirations for my music, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I get what Ichika and Saki want to do.
Because that time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's like Saki's trying to cheer us up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I can almost hear her voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like she's saying, “You're not alone. We're right here.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Getting to be there for the Yoshizakis and support people through our music was pretty great.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if someone were to ask if doing more of that is my top goal... Then, no, not really...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I mean, the reason I started playing the bass is because...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their music has a way of really getting my heart going...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It makes me want to shout out or cry...
I just can't sit still after listening to them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to touch someone's heart with my music, like they did with mine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I have to get better...
I want to become a pro and reach more people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(That feeling's never changed...
The music I heard that day... I still remember everything they played note for note.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which is why... Being asked to come up with another goal is so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (All this thinking is making me tired.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I should do something else.
Maybe watch a video or something and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...
They released their new song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow. I didn't realize.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're as good as ever...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (My heart's dancing the way it always does when I listen to them. I can feel all this excitement welling up inside, and now I wanna play something...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Shih!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What brings you here so late?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, I was wondering how you were doing after we talked earlier! I know you said you wanted to think this over on your own, but I couldn't wait around.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm really sorry if I'm interrupting!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's okay. I was actually just starting to feel tired after thinking so hard.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay. What a relief☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, huh? Were you watching a video just now?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the band I like just uploaded the music video for their new song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, we got to hear a couple of their songs before! This is the band you really look up to, right, Shih?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I decided to start playing the bass because their show had such a huge effect on me. They're why I want to move people's hearts through the music we play.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hey, Shih! I wanna hear all about what happened back then☆>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They're the reason you started playing the bass, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, maybe what you felt in the past will help you find the answer you need for your music's future!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Genius, right?!
Plus, I really wanna know more about what you were like when you were little!>
